english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical competitive sport.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for sports and physical activities.

examples.traditional: 足球係我最鍾意嘅運動。
examples.jyutping: zuk1 kau4 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 wan6 dung6
ngo5 fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 wui5 zou6 wan6 dung6

english.note: Use 運動 as the all-purpose noun for activity aimed at physical fitness, rather than skill practice.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a period of physical exercise.

examples.english: I get some exercise every day to stay healthy.
examples.traditional: 我每日做運動，保持身體健康。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 zou6 wan6 dung6 bou2 ci4 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1

examples.english: I did a half-hour workout this morning.
examples.traditional: 我朝早做咗半個鐘運動。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zou6 zo2 bun3 go3 zung1 wan6 dung6

english.note: Use this for a social movement, and for physical motion in a scientific or more formal context.
Use this for a sustained public, political, or social campaign such as an environmental campaign.

examples.english: This social movement is fighting for equal rights.
examples.traditional: 呢個社會運動爭取緊平等權利。
examples.jyutping: nei1 go3 se5 wui6 wan6 dung6 zang1 ceoi2 gan2 ping4 dang2 kyun4 lei6

examples.english: The campaign to protect the oceans needs everyone to take part.
examples.traditional: 保護海洋運動需要大家一齊參加。
examples.jyutping: bou2 wu6 hoi2 joeng4 wan6 dung6 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 caam1 gaa1
